materials: Production texture atlas for a warm Brazilian neighborhood illustrated 2D isometric RPG. EXACT 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equally sized square material swatches, edge to edge with no borders or gaps, no text or labels. TOP LEFT: warm honey colored wooden boards with fine hand-painted grain, restrained cel shaded gouache texture. TOP RIGHT: pale cream lime plaster, subtle soft mottling, very low contrast, no bricks. BOTTOM LEFT: terracotta orange ceramic curved roof tiles seen from straight above as a flat rectangular texture with neat horizontal courses, hand painted dark outlines and golden highlights. BOTTOM RIGHT: deep petrol teal painted wood planks, subtle wood grain and gentle wear at seams. Entire atlas is orthographic FLAT surface materials only, NO perspective, no objects, no shadows of objects, no room, no bevel border. Art direction: clean confident dark brown outlines, broad simple color masses, limited fine detail, warm upper left painted highlights, polished colorful console RPG illustration, never photo, never noisy grunge. We will map these materials onto mathematically exact isometric geometry in the engine, so these images must have NO isometric projection of their own.
facades: Create a production texture atlas for a polished hand-painted 2D Brazilian neighborhood RPG. An EXACT 2 by 2 grid, four equally sized square panels edge to edge with no gaps, no border, no text, no labels. Every panel is a completely FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC FRONT ELEVATION of ONLY a cream plaster wall, NOT a building illustration. NO perspective, NO roofs, NO ground, NO side walls, NO diagonal lines, NO isometric projection. The wall fills the entire panel. Top-left panel: a two-story home wall, pale warm cream plaster, a wide arched teal wooden entrance door at bottom center reaching 45 percent of panel height, small teal shuttered window to left on ground floor, large teal shuttered window with a leafy flower box centered above the door upstairs, a thin wood horizontal trim between floors. Top-right panel: a single-story professor's cottage wall, warm cream plaster, wide arched teal entrance door at bottom center reaching 70 percent of panel height, small square teal shuttered window left of door, a few carefully drawn ivy leaves at the right edge, brass lantern over door. Bottom-left panel: a kite shop front wall, cream plaster with muted burnt coral base, an arched dark teal shop entrance centered at bottom reaching 70 percent of panel height, flat orange/gold striped canvas awning across the upper doorway, bright paper diamond kites hanging on either side, tiny display of paper rolls. Bottom-right panel: cream SIDE WALL elevation of a cottage, one teal shuttered window centered, tiny flowering creeper at right edge, subtle brown stone plinth at bottom. All doors must touch the exact bottom of the panel and be centered horizontally. All windows are square or rectangular and perfectly level in this flat front view. Style: clean dark brown illustrated contours, colorful cozy console RPG, detailed wood grain and subtle lime plaster brushwork, warm light from upper left, gentle cel shadows, flat readable color masses. Sophisticated 2D illustration, no realistic photographs, no grunge, no diagrams. We will map each panel to a mathematically exact isometric wall plane in our game; adding any perspective here would ruin that mapping.
furniture: Production hand-painted 2D RPG furniture surface texture atlas. EXACT 2 by 2 grid with four equal SQUARE panels, edge to edge, no gaps, borders, labels, text or perspective. All panels are FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC elevations, never isometric, and must fill their panel. TOP LEFT: entire FRONT of a warm honey wood bookshelf with 3 shelves, a varied cozy collection of books with colored teal, cream, terracotta and olive spines, some leaning books, a few scrolls and a little paper diamond kite ornament, deep brown recesses, no feet or protrusions outside frame. TOP RIGHT: entire FRONT of an artisan kite shop wood cabinet with 3 shelves stocked with colorful thread spools, rolled paper, small cream material boxes, warm handmade variety, no text. BOTTOM LEFT: flat FRONT of a wide counter cabinet: petrol teal painted wood panels with honey wood frames, 3 wide drawers, round brass handles, subtle wear at edges, cream diamond kite inlay at center. BOTTOM RIGHT: straight overhead view of an artisan workbench tabletop, warm honey wood grain, cream kite blueprint sheet diagonally centered showing a clean teal diamond kite drawing, a wooden ruler, scissors, 2 spools and a small pencil cup arranged near the upper right edge. Do NOT render any 3D depth or legs. Style: clean dark brown outlines, polished colorful illustrated console RPG, broad cel shading, gentle brush grain, nuanced charming details that read at small size; no photorealism, no tiny noise. These four images are MATERIAL PANELS to be mapped onto exact mathematical furniture planes, so adding perspective would ruin them.
